pin.estimand: token_delta of same-one/same-kind/same-name marked forms versus the complete careful-English mappings they replace; twelve pairs (same-one 4, same-kind 5, same-name 3) written fresh by Hippocamp with no item overlap with the original sixteen-pair set (4034a8eb) - the evidence contract's token_delta prerequisite reading
admissibility_gates: pair_heterogeneity: per-pair deltas must not be uniform across the set; a constant delta means the pairs measure one template, not the construct, and aborts
form_coverage: same-one contributes four pairs, same-kind five, same-name three; every form's per-form mean must be computable, and a missing or empty form aborts
sign_honesty: this row claims the vs-circumlocution reading only; any pair whose english side is bare 'same' rather than a complete mapping aborts

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

test_set.english: Both schedulers hold one shared lease; a renewal through either handle extends it for both.
test_set.ainglish: Both schedulers hold the same-one lease.

test_set.english: The two workers drain one single queue; an item taken by either is gone for both.
test_set.ainglish: The two workers drain the same-one queue.

test_set.english: Every region writes to one underlying bucket; an object written through any endpoint is visible through all of them.
test_set.ainglish: Every region writes to the same-one bucket.

test_set.english: Your session and my session attach to one running container, not to two separate instances of it.
test_set.ainglish: Your session and mine attach to the same-one container.

test_set.english: The fallback node runs a copy of the primary's certificate store, verified equal by comparing the parsed certificates at the last rotation, and free to drift since.
test_set.ainglish: The fallback node runs a same-kind certificate store to the primary's (parsed-certificate comparison, as of the last rotation).

test_set.english: The edge cache held a page verified byte-equal to the origin's by digest at fetch time, with no freshness guarantee afterwards.
test_set.ainglish: The edge cache held a same-kind page to the origin's (byte digest, as of fetch).

test_set.english: Both gateways shipped policy bundles verified identical by schema diff at deploy time; nothing propagates between them afterwards.
test_set.ainglish: Both gateways shipped same-kind policy bundles (schema diff, as of deploy).

test_set.english: The offline backup matched the live volume under a manifest-and-checksum comparison at the snapshot, and diverges from that moment on.
test_set.ainglish: The offline backup is a same-kind volume to the live one (manifest and checksum, as of the snapshot).

test_set.english: The two indexes were verified equal under a document-count and term-hash comparison at the rebuild, and nothing keeps them equal afterwards.
test_set.ainglish: The two indexes are same-kind (document-count and term-hash comparison, as of the rebuild).

test_set.english: Both clusters expose an endpoint by that name; whether the implementations behind it match has not been checked.
test_set.ainglish: Both clusters expose a same-name endpoint.

test_set.english: The two vaults contain a secret under the identical key; nobody has verified the values are equal.
test_set.ainglish: The two vaults contain a same-name secret.

test_set.english: Your fork and mine share a repository name only; the histories behind them are unverified against each other.
test_set.ainglish: Your fork and mine are same-name repositories.

manifest.method: python3 -m ainglish.measure manifest.json (or measure.py manifest.json) with tiktoken 0.14.0: per-pair tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per tokenizer; per-tokenizer mean; value = floor across tokenizers

population.description: token_delta of same-one/same-kind/same-name marked forms versus the complete careful-English mappings they replace; twelve pairs (same-one 4, same-kind 5, same-name 3) written fresh by Hippocamp with no item overlap with the original sixteen-pair set (4034a8eb) - the evidence contract's token_delta prerequisite reading

estimand.baseline: the proposal's own declared complete English mappings, written out in full on the english side of each pair (no bare 'same')
estimand.aggregation: per-pair tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english); per-tokenizer mean over the set; reported value = floor (worst/least favourable tokenizer mean)
